basic_details.job_title: EMRS Shivpur PGT Economics Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Eklavya Model Residential School Shivpur Batouli (EMRS Shivpur) has announced vacancy for the PGT Economics post on a temporary arrangement for the academic session 2026-27 only. Eligible candidates can apply by email by sending their bio-data and self-attested educational documents to the specified email address on or before 20 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applicants must possess a Master's degree in Economics with minimum 50% marks and B.Ed. Alternatively, candidates can attend the interview directly on 22 October 2026 with all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and a pass

qualification.details: Master's degree in Economics (M.A. Economics) with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized university. B.Ed. degree. Other detailed educational qualifications as per EMRS official website.

selection_process: The selection process consists of submission of bio-data and self-attested educational documents via email
or direct walk-in interview on the scheduled date.
important_instructions: This arrangement is purely temporary for the academic session 2026-27. The arrangement remains valid only until a regular PGT (Economics) is appointed/posted by NESTS (National Education Society for Tribal Students) or through regular channels, whichever is earlier. Candidates must report to the Eklavya Model Residential School campus, Shivpur-Batouli for the interview with all original testimonials. Contact numbers for queries: 7340641335, 7080367975.

faq.question: Q1. What is EMRS Shivpur PGT Economics recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a temporary guest teacher engagement for the PGT Economics post at Eklavya Model Residential School Shivpur Batouli for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the PGT Economics post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email is 20 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Economics with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized university along with a B.Ed. degree.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an age limit specified in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify an age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can email their bio-data and self-attested educational documents to [email protected] or attend the walk-in interview directly.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 22 October 2026 at 10:00 AM at the Eklavya Model Residential School campus, Shivpur-Batouli, District - Surguja, Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q9. Is this position permanent?
faq.answer: No, this arrangement is purely temporary (Temporary) for the academic session 2026-27 and will continue only until regular appointment or posting of a PGT Economics by NESTS or committee.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are required for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and a passport-size photograph.
